_README: Copy this file to 'appsettings.json' in the same directory and fill in the
placeholders. appsettings.json is gitignored — never commit a filled-in copy.
Tuning values (AI, Caching, limits) are real defaults and work as-is.
Anything written as <ANGLE_BRACKETS> must be replaced before the app will boot.
Sections you don't use can be deleted; the app degrades to disabling that feature.

Dropbox._note: Powers the ebook reader's Dropbox source. Create an app at https://www.dropbox.com/developers/apps and generate a refresh token.

Spotify._note: Spotif-inator server-side Authorization Code flow. RedirectUri must exactly match the Spotify dashboard allowlist entry.

PhotoPrint._note: Immich -> CVS pickup prints. See DOCS/features/google-photos-cvs-print-automation-spec.md. Enabled=false keeps the endpoints unmapped until Immich is running. The automation always stops at the CVS order review page; the purchase click is manual by design.

DataProtection._note: Persist ASP.NET encryption keys across deploys or stored Spotify tokens cannot be decrypted.

LibraryWatcher._note: Watches the ebook library folder and auto-tags new arrivals.

AudiobookWatcher._note: DryRun logs what it would rename without touching files. Leave it on until you trust the renamer. TestLimit caps how many items a single pass handles (null = no cap).

Listenarr._note: Audiobook discovery/acquisition backend. Keep Enabled false until the read-only gate passes. The API key remains server-side and must never be sent to the browser.
Listenarr._autoSearchNote: AutoSearch is on: an ordinary request lets Listenarr pick its own release. A stated narrator/language preference or an abridged edition always falls back to manual release review, and series requests never search automatically.

GoogleBooks._note: Optional. Metadata enrichment falls back to OpenLibrary when absent.

Auth._note: AccessCodes must be BCrypt hashes (strings starting with $2). Plaintext codes are no longer supported. Generate with any BCrypt tool at cost 12.
Auth._note_initial: Initial is optional: one letter shown in the presence indicator, and the opt-in for appearing there. Omit it everywhere and the app falls back to inferring M/D from a '(Mom)'/'(Dad)' suffix in the name.
Auth._note_id: Id is optional and is the owner key for everything a person owns (Spotify connection and plans, audiobook requests, photo print runs, AI spend). Omit it and the id is derived from Code, which means rotating that person's code moves their data out from under them. Set it once — any short opaque string — and a rotation is invisible. Changing an Id that is already in use is migrated automatically at startup; changing it twice in one deploy is not.

Email._note: Used to send ebooks to Kindle. With Gmail this must be an App Password, not the account password.

YouTube._note: Parked feature. The video-library UI route is removed; set Enabled to true to bring the download endpoints back.

Gaming._note: Wake-on-LAN / remote power control. PcIp is the target machine; omit the section to disable the feature.

OpenAI._note_allowance: Per-user spend cap in USD. Resets on the 1st of each calendar month.

AI._note: Real defaults — tuned, safe to leave alone. Per-task token ceilings and temperatures.

Caching._note: ChapterContentCacheSize: max chapters held in memory. AuthorSuggestionCacheSize: max author lookup results cached.
